Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations

Interface MigrationRepository

All Known Implementing Classes:
DatabaseMigrationRepository
@Internal public interface MigrationRepository
Records which migrations ran and in which batch.

A batch groups the migrations of one run, so a rollback can undo the last run as a unit. Batch numbers start at 1.

Methods added to this interface after version 0.1 are default methods, so an implementation written against an earlier version keeps compiling.

API Note:
Internal: not an extension point; Migrator works with DatabaseMigrationRepository; may change without notice.
Implementation Note:
Order among entries of the same batch follows the database's collation, so names that differ only in letter case may sort differently on different databases.

  • Method Details

    • getRan

      List<String> getRan()
      Returns the names of every migration that ran.
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable list ordered by batch, then name, ascending; never null

    • getMigrations

      List<MigrationEntry> getMigrations(int steps)
      Returns the most recent entries, for a rollback by steps.
      Parameters:
      steps - the most entries to return, at least 1
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable list ordered by batch, then name, descending; never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if steps is below 1

    • getMigrationsByBatch

      List<MigrationEntry> getMigrationsByBatch(int batch)
      Returns the entries of one batch.
      Parameters:
      batch - the batch number
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable list ordered by name, descending; never null, empty when the batch has no entries

    • getLast

      List<MigrationEntry> getLast()
      Returns the entries of the highest batch.
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable list ordered by name, descending; never null, empty when no migration ran

    • getMigrationBatches

      Map<String,Integer> getMigrationBatches()
      Returns the batch of every migration that ran.
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable map from name to batch, iterated in getRan() order; never null

    • log

      void log(String name, int batch, String checksum)
      Records that a migration ran.
      Parameters:
      name - the migration name, never null; non-blank, at most 191 characters, without control characters
      batch - the batch number, at least 1
      checksum - the checksum the migration declared, or null to record none, which the migrator never checks
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if name is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is invalid or batch is below 1
      UniqueConstraintViolationException - if the name is already recorded

    • checksums

      default Map<String,Optional<String>> checksums()
      Returns the checksum recorded for every migration that ran.
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable map from name to checksum, iterated in getRan() order; the value is empty for a migration that has none; never null
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - if the implementation does not keep checksums
      Implementation Requirements:
      The default throws UnsupportedOperationException, so implementations written before checksums existed keep compiling.

    • setChecksum

      default void setChecksum(String name, Optional<String> checksum)
      Replaces the checksum recorded for a migration.
      Parameters:
      name - the migration name, never null; a name that is not recorded changes nothing
      checksum - the new checksum, never null; empty to clear it
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      UnsupportedOperationException - if the implementation does not keep checksums
      Implementation Requirements:
      The default throws UnsupportedOperationException.
